messages:
maria: FYI planning v2 rollout tonight 22:00 PT. Canary 5% -> 25% over 20m, then 100% if green. We'll keep v1 pinned for mobile SDKs for 72h to avoid schema churn.

kai: Sounds good. Any header gating? :thinking_face:

maria: header gate: X-Redwood-Client-Version and x-api-version fallback. If client omits version we route to v1 for 72h.

alex: tagging @mobile-team — can you confirm SDK pin is feasible? Need a quick patch to ignore new optional fields.

mobile-team: will cut SDK patch and push hotfix to package repo by 20:30 PT. expect minimal changes.

jen: add release notes blurb and note that embeddings endpoint signature unchanged. Also adding canary health checks in console.

deploy-bot: initiating canary rollout: route=api-v2, percent=5, strategy=gradual, window=20m

deploy-bot: canary: 5% live -> monitoring traces/latency/errors

maria: monitoring dashboards: latency, 5xx by route, model-fallback-rate, and client-compat-errors. If model-fallback-rate > 2% for 10m -> rollback.

alex: also set automated fallback: if response schema mismatch detected (json schema mismatch) -> degrade to v1 for that request and flag telemetry.

deploy-bot: autoscale hook applied: min_instances=10, max_instances=200, cold_start_buffer=30s

oncall-bot: paging policy set: sev2 if 5xx spike > 1.5x baseline for 5m. paged: @oncall

jen: release-notes draft link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/release-notes/v2-rollout (will update after canary)

maria: rollback command if needed:

maria: ```
/ops/deploy rollback --route api-v2 --to=stable-v1 --reason="compat-failure" --notify=all
```

kai: btw ensure client header case-insensitive matching. Last time mobile sent X-Api-Version and we lost routing.

maria: added header normalizer in gateway: lower-case keys. pushing config now.

deploy-bot: config applied: gateway.header_normalize=true

mobile-team: patch merged, will publish at 20:15 PT. Will send test clients to staging now.

alex: run quick smoke: curl -H 'X-Api-Version: 2' https://api.redwood.com/v2/health

maria: if all green we promote to 25% at 22:25 PT and then ramp to 100% at 22:50 PT. Final notes: pin window for v1-> 72h; opt-in toggles available for partners.

jen: I'll publish release notes + changelog after final promote. :shipit:

maria: thanks everyone, monitoring channel #eng-oncall. I'll post final status updates there.
